description: Dated deals that changed who sells device products: acquisitions, mergers, carve-outs (Stryker's US spinal implants to VB Spine), spin-offs and renames, each in a sentence with what it means for a rep and its source. Filter by company (as asked, as it reported, or its owner now), procedure family (companies with FDA decisions in it) and since (YYYY-MM-DD). With a family and a place, each deal counts the surgeons there the company that changed hands engaged in the three years before it, naming the busiest the plan shows.

cities.description: Cities within the state, to narrow it.

company.description: A company, e.g. NuVasive, Globus or Exactech.

counties.description: 5-digit county FIPS codes forming a custom territory.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

metro.description: Metro area by name ("Charlotte") or 5-digit CBSA code (16740). Can cross state lines.

since.description: Only deals closed since this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. NC. Omit when giving a metro or counties.

zips.description: 5-digit ZIP codes forming a custom territory (as my_territories returns them).
